title: AeroTrace revenue management app
tagline: Ranks the flights departing in the next 14 days by risk and compares each one with a benchmark.

shots.caption: Nine monthly KPIs against the same day last year, yesterday's sales mix and a sales map.

params.alt: AeroTrace dashboard, with dummy numbers and placeholder names: nine KPI cards compared with the same day last year, a sales panel for yesterday with revenue contribution bars, and a sales map.

shots.caption: AeroTrace, a revenue management app built as a personal project.
A watchlist scores every flight departing in the next 0 to 14 days and flags its risk.

params.alt: RM Intelligence watchlist, with dummy numbers and placeholder names: 60 flight cards, each with a score, load factor, yesterday's yield change and a risk type such as normal, spill or yield dilution.

shots.caption: Each flight shows a projected final load factor against a benchmark and a recommended action.

params.alt: Flight detail panel, overview tab, with dummy numbers and placeholder names: the watchlist score, current bookings and revenue, the projected final load factor against a benchmark, and the recommendation.

shots.caption: The flight's booking curve is drawn against the reference curve and a forecast.

params.alt: Flight detail panel, charts tab: the flight's daily load factor over the last 30 days before departure against the reference booking curve and a forecast line.

shots.caption: Bookings break down by class with net seats, share and average fare.

params.alt: Flight detail panel, booking class tab, with dummy numbers: classes sold, and a table of net seats, share and average fare for each booking class.

callouts.label: Seats, share and fare per class

shots.caption: A React and TypeScript front end reads a GraphQL API on Node.js, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.
